About Turing: 
 Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
 Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.
 
 Role Overview 
 We’re seeking a German Voice Actor for a multi-speaker diarization project involving natural, unscripted group conversations on assigned topics. This is a group recording task requiring active participation throughout the session.
 
 Key Responsibilities & Requirements 
 • Attend the full session at the assigned date, time, and time zone.
• Speak clearly, respond to others, ask questions, and contribute fairly.
• Follow topic guidance and use natural reactions without reading a script.
• Provide the required recording equipment and a quiet environment.
 Recording Setup 
 • External microphone with wired headphones preferred; a high-quality wired headset with a built-in microphone is acceptable.
• No Bluetooth earphones, laptop speakers, or open speakers.
• Use the same equipment for your application audio sample and project session.
• Ensure clear audio without background noise, echo, distortion, or microphone handling noise.
 Availability 
 You must attend at the exact assigned date, time, and time zone and actively contribute throughout the session. Silent attendance is not acceptable.
 
 Perks & Offer 
 • Fully remote work on AI projects with leading LLM companies.
• Potential contract extension based on performance and project needs.
• Flexible agreement; not full-time or part-time employment.
 Evaluation Process 
 Candidates will be shortlisted based on qualifications and relevant experience, followed by a delivery review before starting.

About Turing:
 Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
 Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

 Role Overview: 
 We are seeking experienced US-based Medical Doctors to evaluate and improve large language model (LLM) outputs related to Electronic Health Records (EHR), Electronic Medical Records (EMR), and Hospital Information Systems (HIS).
 In this role, you will review AI-generated clinical content, patient records, medical summaries, diagnoses, and treatment recommendations for medical accuracy, safety, completeness, and relevance. Your expertise will help improve the quality and reliability of AI systems used in healthcare.
 This opportunity is open to physicians specializing in:
 • Internal / General Medicine
• Family Medicine / General Practice
• Pediatrics
• Emergency Medicine
 What You’ll Do Day-to-Day: 
 • Review AI-generated clinical content and medical documentation for accuracy, safety, and completeness.
• Evaluate patient histories, clinical notes, diagnoses, treatment plans, and discharge summaries.
• Assess the quality and relevance of AI-generated outputs within EHR/EMR/HIS workflows.
• Identify medical errors, omissions, inconsistencies, and potential patient-safety risks.
• Provide clear, evidence-based feedback to improve AI-generated medical content.
• Follow detailed evaluation guidelines and complete structured questionnaires.
• Collaborate with AI researchers, clinicians, and project teams to align model performance with clinical standards.
 Requirements: 
 • Based in the United States (mandatory). 
• Licensed and actively practicing physician in the USA.
• Medical Doctor (MD), Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO), or internationally trained physician with valid US licensure.
• Minimum 3 years of clinical practice experience in one of the following domains: • Internal / General Medicine
• Family Medicine / General Practice
• Pediatrics
• Emergency Medicine
 
• Practical experience using or reviewing EHR, EMR, or HIS platforms.
• Strong understanding of clinical documentation, medical terminology, and evidence-based care.
• Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify subtle medical inaccuracies.
• Technically comfortable using web-based annotation platforms, digital tools, and structured review forms.
• Strong written communication skills and ability to clearly explain clinical reasoning.
• Experience in clinical research, medical content review, healthcare technology, annotation, or AI/ML evaluation is preferred.

 Offer Details: 
 • Engagement type: Contractor
 • Engagement Length: upto 2 weeks
 • Availability: Full timers and Part timers both are welcome
 Evaluation Process -
 • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
 • Finalized talents will go through delivery interview or assessment & proceeded further accordingly.
